title: Agent Skills: runx Inside Claude and Codex
content: runx skills are governed by the runx runtime, not by a model following prose. `runx export` makes those governed skills available *inside* an agent such as Claude Code or Codex: each runx skill becomes a native agent skill whose only job is to call the runx binary. The agent brings the judgment; runx admits the authority, performs the act, and returns a signed receipt.
